01_ablation.what: accuracy cost (points) of dropping the reranker or the bigger encoder

02_ab_latency.what: median latency saving (ms or %), or the two medians

03_dose_response.what: IC50 of the most potent compound (nM)

04_battery_fade.what: cycle at which the baseline reaches 80% retention

05_retrofit.what: Lab annex median daily drop after retrofit (%), or kWh saved per day

06_energy_mix.what: renewable share of generation without biomass (%)

07_gene_change.what: CDKN1A fold change, or the p53-target / proliferation group medians (×)

08_hall_petch.what: Cu-Zn Hall-Petch slope (MPa·µm^½) or its r

09_eval_matrix.what: Swahili × math now (%), its gain over the previous checkpoint, or before

10_incident.what: payments peak error rate, or its ratio to the usual rate

h1_survey.what: Support's share satisfied or very satisfied (%)

h2_spectra.what: red shift of the 400 °C sample's peak (nm), or its peak position

h3_wait_times.what: South−North median wait gap at triage level 3 (min), or the two medians
